collection.title: Mercedes-Benz GLE Class SUV 2015 to 2018 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Mercedes-Benz GLE Class SUV 2015 - 2018 (166) will fit, this model requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 24" for the passengers side. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this GLE Class which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
